title: A fix touches only the fault
statement: A fix a checker proposes changes only the faulty span, keeps the objective and the useful teaching content, and adds no unsupported claim.
detail: An evaluation design for an AI judge lets a correction alter only the span it cites, keep the useful teaching content and the learning objective, and avoid unsupported claims (`uae-education-ai/EVALUATION.md`). Its scoring penalizes unnecessary edits on cases that already follow the rule and vague requests for evidence on cases that can't be decided. The criteria are a design that had not been run.

evidence.quote: A correction may alter only the cited span, preserve useful teaching content and the learning objective, and avoid unsupported claims.
penalize unnecessary edits on compliant cases and vague evidence requests on insufficient cases.
YOUR PREVIOUS DRAFT FAILED THESE CHECKS. Fix every one and return the whole JSON again:
"q": "According to Iago, what is his only reason for continuing to serve Othello?",
"sentence_0_2": "The phrase \"long remember\" implies that official speeches leave almost no mark on history.",
"sentence_0_1": "The phrase long remember suggests that spoken dedications carry minimal lasting weight in human history.",

One licensed form edit exists: where an AUTHORED distractor breaks a form rule (e.g. it leaves the correct answer the single longest or shortest option), the generator may minimally rephrase THAT distractor, recording it in `_gates.form_edits`.
The stem and the correct option are never touched — the fidelity gate enforces exactly that split.
a reader who knows the authored option must still recognize it
Replacing a distractor's scenario with a new one is not a form edit, it is a rewrite, and a rewrite of authored content fails the lesson.

Do NOT delete the whole third sentence as the finding proposed; deleting it strips the use-today's-word directive and makes L6 weaker than L4/L5/L7, which all keep it. Keep the directive, drop the letter and the colon.
